hash_readers.invalid_initial_attempt: Missing required source-root field; refused before preparation, excluded. Valid fixed bindings retain root=src.
hash_readers.scope: Original confined application preparation, complete exact byte fingerprints and equal compute/Python resources. No concurrent build/test/sampler. Production remains four readers; no partial result or metadata-only shortcut.

limits: Camera identities are presentation state, not source/meaning/evidence authority.
Stable current IDs are matched with their original file/name; missing IDs are rebound only by a unique current file/name. This is not a proof of semantic identity for arbitrary source edits.
Isolated component inputs are not backend publications or native worker validation. Installed real tools and scripted native/TUI fixtures are not live-model/cold-install validation.
Sampled frames are not physical display measurements. Inclusive event/long-task intervals overlap and must not be summed.
Replay timings include forced pixel readback; prebuilt timings exclude construction and do not predict first-paint latency. Existing caches and desktop activity are not reset.
